# Copilot Attribution Policy (Strict)

When generating or modifying any file content in this workspace, you must add one attribution comment for each newly generated block created in the current response.

Required attribution text:
AUTO-GENERATED by GitHub Copilot

Scope:
- Applies to code, scripts, config files, markdown docs, and prose files.
- Applies to newly created files and newly generated sections in existing files.

Rules:
- Match language comment style:
  - Python, shell, YAML, TOML, Dockerfile: # ...
  - JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C, C++, Rust, Go, Kotlin, Swift, C#: // ...
  - CSS: /* ... */
  - HTML, XML, Markdown: <!-- ... -->
- Add the attribution immediately above the generated block, or at file top for fully generated small files.
- Do not add duplicate attribution comments if one already exists for that generated block.
- Do not add attribution to unchanged user-authored content.
- Preserve existing project style.

Enforcement:
- Do not omit attribution for generated content.
- If comment syntax is ambiguous, use the safest valid format for that file type.
